findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "seller_compliance.which_certificate" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seller_compliance.shipment_held · Private data: seller_compliance.which_certificate, seller_compliance.marketplace_asks, seller_compliance.screen_supplier, seller_compliance.shipment_held · Public sink: seller_compliance.marketplace_asks, seller_compliance.shipment_held.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seller_compliance.shipment_held · Private data: seller_compliance.which_certificate, seller_compliance.marketplace_asks, seller_compliance.screen_supplier, seller_compliance.shipment_held · Public sink: seller_compliance.marketplace_asks, seller_compliance.shipment_held

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
